tasks.directive: Use video_frame_extract to examine the entire opening sequence from 0:00 to 4:25 for any on-screen text, title cards, or visual cues that might indicate the title of the montage. Specifically look for text overlays, subtitles, or any visual elements that spell out a name (e.g., 'Married Life', 'A Life in Pictures', etc.). If no text is found, confirm the sequence is a life montage by analyzing recurring props (camera, lightbulb, book, etc.) and editing style (montage cuts, emotional progression).
